Toast the bread for itHow to make it6 garlic cloves80ml extra virgin olive oil8 slices of ciabatta2 tomatoes, halved1 handful basilsalt, to tasteSlice the garlic paper thin on a mandoline.Cook the garlic in the olive oil over low heat until soft and barely golden.Grill the ciabatta, rub with the cut side of the tomatoes and season with salt.Spoon over the garlic and its oil and finish with torn basil.Salami, prosciutto, cheeseLaid out on the board, like the cellHow to make it150g sliced Genoa salami100g prosciutto200g sharp provolone150g pepperoncini150g marinated mushrooms1 loaf seeded Italian breadCut the provolone into thick batons.Arrange the salami, prosciutto and provolone on a board.Put the pepperoncini and marinated mushrooms in small bowls beside the board.Tear the Italian bread by hand and set it next to the board.MainsSauce on, three-meat meatballsVeal, beef and pork. Go easy on the onionsHow to make it2 slices of bread80ml milk200g veal mince200g beef mince200g pork mince1 egg40g pecorino, grated2 tbsp chopped parsley5 garlic cloves1/2 onion, diced800g San Marzano tomatoes, tinned500g spaghetti2 tbsp olive oilSoak the bread in the milk, then mix with the minces, egg, pecorino, parsley and 1 crushed garlic clove.Roll into 16 balls and brown in olive oil.In the same pot gently cook the remaining garlic sliced razor thin and the onion, add the tomatoes and the meatballs, and simmer.Cook the spaghetti and serve with the sauce and meatballs.Johnny Dio's pan steaksRare or medium.
